note: Rulings that are DECIDED but cannot be executed yet, because the mechanism they depend on does not exist. Each names its blocker, its exit condition, and the certified figure it will move. A ruling parked here is not an open question — it is settled work waiting on a prerequisite.
whyThisFileExists: The alternative is worse in both directions. Applying a ruling before its mechanism exists loses meaning: withdrawing "Non-profit organization" today would leave [NP] in #5 and #6 with nothing separating them from Nancy Pelosi, which is the exact outcome the original ruling was written to prevent. Leaving it undocumented instead turns a temporary hold into a permanent contradiction, where the entity registry disagrees with the audit and nothing on record says why.
